description:
FOUND s495 (Fable) by the s492c MERGE REVIEW probes (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s495/review/s492c/: r1997.pl r1997w.pl r2050.pl r2050w.pl r1743.pl rb64.pl r2007.pl ft1.pl tw1.pl; each has .perl / .base / .tree).  None is a regression (the base died earlier on every file); each is a gap between what the batch's task titles claim and what an ordinary call meets.
  (1) POSIX (#1997 "becomes a real module", 21 of 25 probe rows right): `POSIX::uname`, `POSIX::times`, `POSIX::dup2`, `POSIX::setsid` do not exist (LOUD: Undefined subroutine); `setlocale(LC_ALL, "C")` returns the PREVIOUS locale name (`en_US.UTF-8`) where perl returns the NEW one (`C`) -- silent.  Daemon code is `setsid` + `dup2`; `uname` is every "what am I running on" script.
  (2) `use Module VERSION` is not enforced: `eval "use List::Util 999; 1"` LOADS (perl: "List::Util version 999 required--this is only version 1.63").  #1743 made `->VERSION(N)` real; the `use` statement's version argument has to CALL it.  Silent in the permissive direction: a script that guards on a minimum version runs against an older module.  Probe `use Module VERSION LIST`, `use Module VERSION ()`, `require Module; Module->VERSION(N)`, a v-string version, `use 5.010` (must stay the perl-version form).
  (3) regex escapes beside #2050: `/^\N{3}$/` (a QUANTIFIED \N: perl matches "abc") does not match; `"A" =~ /\N{U+41}/` does not match although the STRING form `"\N{U+41}"` is right; `\X` takes ONE character (or CRLF), never base + combining marks -- the third is the agent's documented approximation and waits for #2060's property tables, the first two are small.
  (4) `lib/File/Spec/Functions.pm` (a PRE-EXISTING shim, not s492c's): @EXPORT lacks `canonpath` (perl exports it BY DEFAULT) and @EXPORT_OK lacks `catpath` `abs2rel` `case_tolerant` -- `use File::Spec::Functions qw(canonpath)` imports nothing and the call dies "Undefined subroutine &main::canonpath".  One-line shim fix; compare the two lists with the real module's.
  (5) NOT a bug, recorded so nobody chases it: `system("exit 6")` is -1 in perl (no shell metacharacter, so perl execs a program called `exit`, which does not exist) and 6 in PCL (always through the shell).  Rare; decide with #2107/#2101's family whether PCL should mimic the no-metacharacter direct exec.
ALREADY FILED by the batch, cited here so the picture is whole: #2056 `File::Temp->new`, #2059 MIME::QuotedPrint, #2060 `\pM` (Text::Wrap still dies on EVERY wrap() call), #2065 POSIX errno numbers are this machine's.
BAR: lib/ + cl/ => full sweep, the companion legs of the touched families, `tools/everyday-smoke.pl` before -> after (rows `modules/Text-Wrap-ParseWords-Abbrev` and `modules/File-Temp` do not move with this task -- they are #2060 / #2056).

NOTE (s499k, 2026-09-27): item (3)'s first half -- `/^\N{3}$/` (a QUANTIFIED \N) -- is FIXED by #2471.  `/\N{U+41}/` and `/\N{NAME}/` in a pattern are still unresolved (the scan copies them; no earlier pass resolves them, whatever the old docstring said).  Task stays open.
subject: s492c REVIEW RESIDUES (none a regression): POSIX lacks uname / times / dup2 / setsid and setlocale answers the old locale; `use Module VERSION` is NOT ENFORCED (silent); `\N{3}` and `/\N{U+41}/` do not match; File::Spec::Functions does not export canonpath / catpath / abs2rel
